inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Grit under the fingernails, coal in the throat
The whistle screams a warning I cannot ignore
I pull the lever down, the iron groans
Every carriage holds a stolen season, a stolen bone

[Chorus]
Flip the switch! Burn the track!
Time is bleeding through the cracks!

[Verse]
Platform four is empty, but the shadows breathe
They count the seconds missing from my hand
The conductor looks, his clock face cracks
I shatter it against the rails, the silence snaps

[Bridge]
SLOW. DOWN. STOP. NOW.

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Flip the switch! Burn the track!
Time is bleeding through the cracks!

[Outro]
Last train halts. Years return. The switchman walks.
